attributes.title: 6th Annual KAPN Sunflower Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Kansas Advanced Practice Nurse Professional Development (KSBN Provider LT0349-0626)
attributes.organizer: The Kansas Advanced Practice Nurses Association
attributes.summary:
Kansas APRNs get something handy here: the program is planned to the Kansas State Board of Nursing standards for 11 contact hours, 3 of them pharmacology, and is aimed at APRN re-licensure. The provider number listed is LT0349-0626. It runs February 19 and 20, 2027, in Wichita.

Planned topics are unusually practical, including NP malpractice cases, outpatient antibiotic stewardship, heart failure, opioid use disorder and starting an APRN-owned practice. Friday morning offers three paid workshops, joint injection, suturing and business ownership; you can pick only one.

Early rates end November 29, 2026.
